assumptions: 2D side view of a 4.0 x 2.0 m cabin section, 2.0 m deep
No buoyancy: smoke only moves with the air and by mixing
Mixing D = 0.1 m2/s (flight data allows 0.004 to 0.1) and clearance 170 s, both inside the range tuned on Saffire-III flight data
Alarm times include a 11 s detector delay tuned on the same record
Supply and return positions are illustrative
Screening model, not a full fluid-dynamics simulation
